$comment: Explicit, reviewed allowlist of print_ids whose own verify recomputation is EXPECTED to diverge from their published figures, and why — read by cli/verify-all.ts. Never auto-derived from a heuristic: every entry here is added by hand alongside the correction_notes entry that discloses and quantifies the same divergence, so this file stays a small, honest, human-reviewed record rather than a way to silence a genuinely new failure. A print's own body is never edited to fix these — see docs/methodology.md's revision policy. Deliberately narrow in scope, 2026-09-27: the reasoning-token and cached-input pricing bugs that used to account for 40 of this file's 47 entries are no longer here at all — cli/verify-support.ts now reconstructs each print's own historical cost-formula rules (historical-pricing-rules.ts) the same way it already reconstructs historical rounding, so those prints recompute to an EXACT match instead of a disclosed divergence. What remains is a genuinely different kind of divergence this mechanism doesn't (and isn't meant to) cover: a registry composition change from before computeConstituentChanges existed to disclose it. Making verify recompute against each print's own HISTORICAL registry snapshot, not today's, would close this too, but that's real, versioned-registry-snapshot scope nobody has asked for — disclosed here honestly instead.

divergences.reason: llama-3.3-70b-cloudflare and llama-3.3-70b-novita were both registered (and excluded, per this print's own basket_costs) at the time, but were removed from the registry entirely between 2026-08-29 and 2026-08-30 — before computeConstituentChanges existed to disclose a registry removal automatically. Recomputing today (current registry, missing both) naturally shows them as "model absent from recomputation" rather than "excluded". See 2026-08-30's own retroactive correction note for the full disclosure. A benign, real registry change, not a computation error on either side.
